result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with commercial land use and continuous sidewalks. While a marked crosswalk and curb ramps are present at the corner, the lack of a median refuge and visible traffic control increases pedestrian exposure during crossings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or traffic signals at the immediate intersection to manage vehicle flow for crossing pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corner in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corner to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, four-lane arterial road with commercial land use and sidewalks, but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The absence of marked crosswalks, medians, or traffic calming measures creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians due to long crossing distances and likely high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible despite the presence of commercial destinations.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible stretch of the road.

hazards.name: High-speed design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds in a pedestrian-accessible area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths or the number of lanes to include bike lanes or wider sidewalks, slowing traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible marked crossings or traffic calming measures. While a sidewalk is present along the commercial frontage, it is narrow and lacks a physical buffer from the adjacent parking and travel lanes.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points visible for pedestrians to safely traverse the wide roadway to reach the commercial destination.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway in front of the building.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb can block the view of pedestrians attempting to cross from the sidewalk into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb line.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or more substantial street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation for pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane arterial road intersecting with a smaller side street.
